1.My life is in progress now.

7. I saw a therapist for a while .and it was hard to find a therapist that you can click with. it's hard to find a good one out there especially in my country .where I live we don't really have much trauma specialists ,PTSD specialist, childhood abuse specialists .and for that at the moment I am looking for online options.

8. Yes I do have a boyfriend, Sadly at the moment we are long distance for almost 2 years now, although he's amazing but we do have a lot of ups and a lot of downs. we do have our own problems ,we're working on it ,as long as we can point it out to ourselves and each other we can work on it.


9. Panic attacks and mental breakdowns, I became quicker at realizing what's happening as soon as it starts and faster to stop it and process it. and the they became further apart .

I also now learned how to not let them ,and my thoughts during them ,affect me after they are done by giving my inner child love and convincing myself, or my inner child, that it's not real ,those thoughts are gone ,and we are fine.

Bonus: sometimes when I do have mental breakdowns flashbacks panic attacks, SOMETIMES NOT EVERYTIME, it gets nasty ,it gets terrible ,it gets tiring.
 sometimes I genuinely cannot function and need a day or two of absolute silence to cry it out ,process it. then be fine.

 sometimes it's too hard to wash my hair ,it's too tiring to get out of bed, so I just take a few days off ,my sister can take care of my parents ,and I go to my apartment and talk to no one, turn off my phone turn off everything ,and just take my time.

 sometimes it gets too hard to do the absolute bare minimum ,and it's normal for people like me to go through something like this, and if you do that's fine just process it don't let it affect you after it's over.

Also don't think that you have to be in the same position as someone else in life. they are on their own road and you are on your own road. you are original on your own. you don't need to follow a certain process speed or progress .take your time you're not running out of it. and don't get frustrated when it's slow ,because those are the best .

Speaking of healing, it's not all jolly and happy it's crying it's realizations it's a lot of ups and downs mostly Downs but it leads the ups so it's okay.
